sources.title: What we do not know (yet) about square-tiled surfaces in large genus?
sources.citation: Oberwolfach Report 41/2024, pp.2384–2387 (report DOI publication 14 February 2025)
sources.role_and_limits: Original principal-quadratic iterated-limit intermediate-area question. Its separate printed microscopic 4g−4 formula is not used or identified with 6g−6.

sources.title: Length partition of random multicurves on large genus hyperbolic surfaces
sources.citation: Journal of the European Mathematical Society 27 (2025), 5093–5131; online 7 June 2024
sources.role_and_limits: Prior exact geometric mixture, positive Dirichlet monomials and uniform coefficients; whole-multiset approximation is an extraction from these inputs. Underlying intersection-number asymptotics, including Aggarwal's work, are credited through the cited geometry.

sources.title: Large genus asymptotic geometry of random square-tiled surfaces and of random multicurves
sources.authors: Vincent Delecroix; Élise Goujard; Peter Zograf; Anton Zorich
controlling_locations: Theorem 5.2 in its stated low-k range
sources.role_and_limits: Existing exact zeta-weighted permutation law, geometric correspondence, cylinder-count generating function and exceptional-graph estimates. No new model is claimed.

sources.title: Limits of logarithmic combinatorial structures
sources.authors: Richard Arratia; A. D. Barbour; Simon Tavaré
controlling_locations: Conditioning relation and uniform logarithmic condition
sources.role_and_limits: Prior unmarked count-vector Poisson approximation for every b_n=o(n); here theta=1/2. The geometric marked statement is not attributed to this paper.

sources.title: Independent Process Approximations for Random Combinatorial Structures
controlling_locations: Lemma 5 and equation (126), printed pp.136–137, full proof
sources.role_and_limits: Prior selected-component factorial identity; positive real weights follow by its conditional-Poisson algebra.

sources.title: Independent Process Approximations for Random Combinatorial Structures

sources.title: Random multi-geodesics on hyperbolic surfaces
sources.citation: PhD thesis, Université Paris Cité, defended 27 September 2022
sources.role_and_limits: Prior work-in-progress announcement with Delecroix: all-multiplicity microscopic density, 6g−6 scaling and generalized Ewens law. This public passage is not a proof of moving-window uniformity.
